title: Linked health records data — Death registration and mortality data
description: Death registration and mortality data for individuals that had a death certificate registered in England and Wales.

PID.title: Participant ID
PID.$comment: Many-to-one link to participant.PID; that every PID exists there cannot be enforced across tables (D102). The source states no format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).

ROW_ID.title: OFH generated local key
ROW_ID.$comment: Local primary key: unique within this table (D102). The source states no format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).
